'''Giant lilies''' were a type of [[Planet/Legends|flower]] that were native to the ponds and marshes of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. Anchoring itself to underwater stones, the roots of the giant lily were permanently attached to the rock after they began producing a natural cement. This natural glue was harvested by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] for use in the construction of panels for their [[leafship]]s.
